front.title: Architecture for AI Agent Communications on the Internet

abstract.t: This document defines the terminology and architecture for AI agent communications protocols over the Internet. It provides the foundational architectural elements for the Agent Communications Protocol (ACP) - also known as agentproto - a new protocol to be developed in the IETF. ACP enables communication between user agent clients and AI agents, between AI Agents and other AI Agents, or between AI Agents and tools. All three of these interaction patterns - and the many use cases therein - require a session-like protocol which handles lifecycle management, including creation, modification, deletion and so on - along with the exchange of input and output. These session-like associations can be extremely long lived - running for hours or even days - and span multiple IP hosts used by the both the principal and by the agent. They can also be highly intermittent with asynchronous responses. All of these mean a new type of protocol is needed.
